title: Zoning text change for affordable housing at 100-12 Queens Boulevard
summary: This resolution approves, with modifications, a Zoning Resolution text amendment establishing a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area at 100-12 Queens Boulevard in Forest Hills, Queens. It is tied to a related rezoning that would allow a 21-story mixed-use building with about 389 apartments, including 97 income-restricted units, and 16,000 square feet of commercial space. The City Planning Commission approved the application on September 9, 2026 and the Council held a public hearing on October 6, 2026.
